Perks › Rare

Collector

Rare perk · Scoring bonus

On a scoring play, each distinct double you have played this round adds 2 points.

In-game card text

How it works

On a scoring play, gain +2 points for every different double you have played this hand, for each copy.

  • The double you are playing right now counts if it is new.
  • Playing the same double value twice only counts once; the count resets every hand.

Worked example

You have already played 1-1 and 5-5 this hand and now score with 3-3. That is three different doubles: +6 with one Collector, +12 with two.

At a glance

RarityRare
TypeScoring bonus
Needs a scoring playYes. It only fires when the open-end total is a positive multiple of 5.
How to get itUnlock it in the Perks compendium for 600 Bone Bucks once you own 5 Uncommon perks.
